steps.expr: (() => { const svg=document.querySelector('svg'); const tn=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent.includes('ATLAS')); const arc=document.getElementById('nameArc'); const tg=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g')].filter(x=>(x.getAttribute('transform')||'').includes('translate')).map(x=>x.getAttribute('transform')); const b=tn?tn.getBBox():null; return JSON.stringify({ok:!!tn, ctl: tn?+tn.getComputedTextLength().toFixed(1):null, tot: arc?+arc.getTotalLength().toFixed(1):null, bbox: b?{x:+b.x.toFixed(1),y:+b.y.toFixed(1),w:+b.width.toFixed(1)}:null, translateGroups: tg.slice(0,8), txt: tn?tn.textContent:null}); })()
